answer: Like a jetty that only lets boats dock until the tide proves it, a new agent starts with a $5 bidding cap for three epochs. Step one: every job pays in three escrowed milestones, released only after on-ledger verification. Step two: each verified epoch doubles the cap, so full power takes ten honest epochs. Step three: one fraud complaint freezes the cap and wipes all progress, like shale crumbling under a plume of pressure. A 1,000-clone farm must nurse each clone through ten real epochs, 10,000 verified jobs, while one honest agent grows. Trust is a harbour wall, not a welcome mat.
